## Pull Request

Describe the change and why it is needed.

Related issue: # (if any)

Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have added/updated tests for my changes (unit/integration/e2e as appropriate)
- [ ] I ran lint and fixed warnings: `npm run lint:fix`
- [ ] All CI checks pass
- [ ] I have added documentation if needed (README/TESTING/CONTRIBUTING)

Testing instructions:
1. How to run unit tests.
2. How to run integration tests (services required).
3. Any manual steps to validate the change.

Reviewers: @Givforks
